questions.questionText: The ratio of present ages of father and son is 5 : 2. Four years hence, the ratio of their ages will become 2 : 1. Find the present age of the father.
questions.explanation: Let present ages be 5x and 2x. (5x + 4) / (2x + 4) = 2 / 1 => 5x + 4 = 4x + 8 => x = 4. Father's present age = 5 * 4 = 20 years.

questions.questionText: Six years ago, the ratio of the ages of Kunal and Sagar was 6 : 5. Four years hence, the ratio of their ages will be 11 : 10. What is Sagar's age at present?
questions.explanation: Let ages 6 years ago be 6x and 5x. Present ages: 6x+6 and 5x+6. In 4 years: 6x+10 and 5x+10. (6x + 10)/(5x + 10) = 11/10 => 60x + 100 = 55x + 110 => 5x = 10 => x = 2. Sagar's present age = 5(2) + 6 = 16 years.

questions.questionText: A father said to his son, "I was as old as you are at the present at the time of your birth." If the father's age is 38 years now, what was the son's age five years back?
questions.explanation: Let son's present age be s. Father's age at son's birth = 38 - s. Given: 38 - s = s => 2s = 38 => s = 19 years. Five years back, son's age = 19 - 5 = 14 years.

questions.questionText: The sum of the ages of 5 children born at the intervals of 3 years each is 50 years. What is the age of the youngest child?
questions.explanation: Let ages be x, x+3, x+6, x+9, x+12. Sum = 5x + 30 = 50 => 5x = 20 => x = 4 years.

questions.questionText: A is two years older than B who is twice as old as C. If the total of the ages of A, B, and C be 27, then how old is B?
questions.explanation: Let C = x. Then B = 2x, and A = 2x + 2. Total = (2x + 2) + 2x + x = 5x + 2 = 27 => 5x = 25 => x = 5. B's age = 2 * 5 = 10 years.

questions.questionText: Present ages of Sameer and Anand are in the ratio of 5 : 4 respectively. Three years hence, the ratio of their ages will become 11 : 9 respectively. What is Anand's present age in years?

The average age of a husband and wife was 23 years when they were married 5 years ago. The average age of the husband, wife, and a child who was born during the interval is 20 years now. How old is the child now?
questions.explanation: Sum of H and W 5 years ago = 46. Present sum of H and W = 46 + 10 = 56. Present sum of H, W, child = 3 * 20 = 60. Child's age = 60 - 56 = 4 years.

questions.questionText: Ten years ago, P was half of Q in age. If the ratio of their present ages is 3 : 4, what will be the total of their present ages?
questions.explanation: Present ages: 3x and 4x. 10 years ago: 3x - 10 = (1/2)(4x - 10) => 3x - 10 = 2x - 5 => x = 5. Total present ages = (3 + 4)x = 7 * 5 = 35 years.

questions.questionText: A man is 24 years older than his son. In two years, his age will be twice the age of his son. What is the present age of his son?
questions.explanation: Let son's age be s. Father = s + 24. In 2 years: (s + 24 + 2) = 2(s + 2) => s + 26 = 2s + 4 => s = 22 years.

questions.questionText: The sum of the present ages of a father and his son is 60 years. Six years ago, father's age was five times the age of the son. After 6 years, son's age will be:
questions.explanation: Let son's present age be s. Father = 60 - s. 6 years ago: (60 - s - 6) = 5(s - 6) => 54 - s = 5s - 30 => 6s = 84 => s = 14. After 6 years, son's age = 14 + 6 = 20 years.

questions.questionText: At present, the ratio between the ages of Arun and Deepak is 4 : 3. After 6 years, Arun's age will be 26 years. What is Deepak's present age?
questions.explanation: Arun's present age = 26 - 6 = 20 years. 4x = 20 => x = 5. Deepak's present age = 3 * 5 = 15 years.

questions.questionText: The ratio of the father's age to his son's age is 7 : 3. The product of their ages is 756. What will be the ratio of their ages after 6 years?
questions.explanation: 7x * 3x = 756 => 21 x^2 = 756 => x^2 = 36 => x = 6. Present ages: Father = 42, Son = 18. After 6 years: Father = 48, Son = 24. Ratio = 48 : 24 = 2 : 1.

questions.questionText: In 10 years, A will be twice as old as B was 10 years ago. If A is now 9 years older than B, the present age of B is:
questions.explanation: Let B's age be b. A's age = b + 9. In 10 years: A + 10 = (b + 9) + 10 = b + 19. B 10 years ago = b - 10. Equation: b + 19 = 2(b - 10) => b + 19 = 2b - 20 => b = 39 years.

questions.questionText: The total age of A and B is 12 years more than the total age of B and C. C is how many years younger than A?
questions.explanation: (A + B) = (B + C) + 12 => A = C + 12 => A - C = 12 years. C is 12 years younger than A.

questions.questionText: The present age of a father is 3 years more than three times the age of his son. Three years hence, father's age will be 10 years more than twice the age of the son. Find father's present age.
questions.explanation: Father F = 3s + 3. In 3 years: F + 3 = 2(s + 3) + 10 => (3s + 3) + 3 = 2s + 6 + 10 => 3s + 6 = 2s + 16 => s = 10. Father's present age = 3(10) + 3 = 33 years.

questions.questionText: A person was asked to state his age in years. His reply was, "Take my age three years hence, multiply it by 3 and then subtract three times my age three years ago and you will know how old I am." What was his age?
questions.explanation: Let age be x. Equation: 3(x + 3) - 3(x - 3) = x => (3x + 9) - (3x - 9) = x => 18 = x. His age is 18 years.

questions.questionText: The ages of two persons differ by 16 years. If 6 years ago, the elder one be 3 times as old as the younger one, find their present ages.
questions.explanation: Let younger be y, elder be y + 16. 6 years ago: (y + 16 - 6) = 3(y - 6) => y + 10 = 3y - 18 => 2y = 28 => y = 14. Elder = 14 + 16 = 30 years.

questions.questionText: The ratio of the present ages of a mother and her daughter is 7 : 1. Four years ago, the ratio of their ages was 19 : 1. What will be the mother's age 4 years from now?
questions.explanation: (7x - 4) / (x - 4) = 19 / 1 => 7x - 4 = 19x - 76 => 12x = 72 => x = 6. Mother's present age = 7 * 6 = 42 years. Mother's age 4 years from now = 42 + 4 = 46 years; with x=5: 7*5=35+4=39; with 7x-4=19x-76: 12x=72 -> x=6 -> 42+4 = 46 years.

questions.questionText: My brother is 3 years elder to me. My father was 28 years of age when my sister was born while my mother was 26 years of age when I was born. If my sister was 4 years of age when my brother was born, what was the age of my father when my brother was born?
questions.explanation: Father was 28 when sister was born. Brother was born when sister was 4. Therefore, Father's age when brother was born = 28 + 4 = 32 years.

questions.questionText: The average age of 30 boys in a class is 15 years. If the teacher's age is included, the average age becomes 16 years. What is the teacher's age?
The ratio of ages of Tina and Rakesh is 9 : 10. Ten years ago, the ratio of their ages was 4 : 5. Find the present age of Rakesh.
The sum of the ages of a mother and her daughter is 50 years. Also 5 years ago, the mother's age was 7 times the age of the daughter. What are the present ages of the mother and daughter?
Eighteen years ago, a father was three times as old as his son. Now the father is only twice as old as his son. What is the sum of the present ages of the father and son?

A woman says, "If you reverse my own age, the figures represent my husband's age. He is, of course, senior to me and the difference between our ages is one-eleventh of their sum." How old is the woman?
questions.explanation: Let woman's age be 10t + u and husband's age be 10u + t (u > t). Difference = 9(u - t). Sum = 11(u + t). 9(u - t) = (1/11) * 11(u + t) = u + t => 9u - 9t = u + t => 8u = 10t => 4u = 5t. Since u and t are single digits, t = 4 and u = 5. Woman's age = 45 years.

questions.questionText: The age of father 10 years ago was thrice the age of his son. Ten years hence, father's age will be twice that of his son. What is the ratio of their present ages?
A man's age is 125% of what it was 10 years ago, but 83 1/3 % of what it will be after 10 years. What is his present age?
The ratio of the ages of Priya and Ritu is 3 : 4. Four years ago, the sum of their ages was 20 years. What are their present ages?
questions.explanation: Present sum = 20 + 4 + 4 = 28 years. Ratio 3 : 4 => 7 parts = 28 => 1 part = 4 years. Ages are 3*4 = 12 and 4*4 = 16 years.

questions.questionText: The present ages of three persons are in the ratio 4 : 7 : 9. Eight years ago, the sum of their ages was 56. Find their present ages.
questions.explanation: Present sum = 56 + 3 * 8 = 56 + 24 = 80 years. Ratio 4:7:9 has 20 parts. 1 part = 80 / 20 = 4. Ages are 4*4=16, 7*4=28, 9*4=36 years.

questions.questionText: A father is six times as old as his son. In 18 years, he will be three times as old as his son. What is the father's present age?
questions.explanation: Let the son be s years old; the father is 6s. In 18 years, 6s + 18 = 3(s + 18), so 3s = 36 and s = 12. The father is currently 6*12 = 72 years old.

questions.questionText: The ratio between the present ages of A and B is 5 : 3 respectively. The ratio between A's age 4 years ago and B's age 4 years hence is 1 : 1. What is the ratio between A's age 4 years hence and B's age 4 years ago?
questions.explanation: 5x - 4 = 3x + 4 => 2x = 8 => x = 4. Present ages: A = 20, B = 12. A's age 4 years hence = 24. B's age 4 years ago = 8. Ratio = 24 : 8 = 3 : 1.

questions.questionText: A grandfather was 8 times older than his grandson 10 years ago. He will be 3 times as old as his grandson 10 years hence. Find the grandson's present age.
A father's age is 3 times the sum of ages of his two sons. After 5 years his age will be twice the sum of their ages. Find the present age of the father.
questions.explanation: Let sum of sons' ages be S. F = 3S. In 5 years, each son ages 5 years (sum increases by 10): F + 5 = 2(S + 10) => 3S + 5 = 2S + 20 => S = 15. Father's age = 3 * 15 = 45 years.

questions.questionText: The average age of a family of 6 members is 22 years. If the age of the youngest member be 7 years, what was the average age of the family at the birth of the youngest member?
questions.explanation: Total age now = 6 * 22 = 132 years. 7 years ago, total age of the 5 older members = 132 - 6 * 7 = 132 - 42 = 90 years. Average age of 5 members at birth of youngest = 90 / 5 = 18 years.

questions.questionText: The ratio of present ages of two brothers is 1 : 2 and 5 years back the ratio was 1 : 3. What will be the ratio of their ages after 5 years?
questions.explanation: (x - 5)/(2x - 5) = 1/3 => 3x - 15 = 2x - 5 => x = 10. Present ages: 10 and 20. After 5 years: 15 and 25. Ratio = 15 : 25 = 3 : 5.

questions.questionText: My age is 3 times my son's age. In 15 years, it will be double. What is the sum of our present ages?
A is 16 years older than B. If 6 years ago, A was 3 times as old as B, find the present age of A.
The ratio of the ages of Minu and Meera is 4 : 3. The sum of their ages is 28 years. What will be the ratio of their ages after 8 years?
questions.explanation: 4x + 3x = 28 => 7x = 28 => x = 4. Present: 16 and 12. After 8 years: 24 and 20. Ratio = 24 : 20 = 6 : 5.

questions.questionText: A father tells his son, "Seven years ago, I was seven times as old as you were then. Also, three years from now, I shall be three times as old as you will be." Find the son's present age.
In a family, the average age of father and mother is 35 years. The average age of father, mother, and their only son is 27 years. What is the age of the son?
questions.explanation: Sum of parents = 70. Sum of three = 3 * 27 = 81. Son's age = 81 - 70 = 11 years.
questions.concept: Direct Son Age from Mean Delta

questions.questionText: A person's present age is two-ninths of the age of his mother. After 10 years, he will be four-elevenths of the age of his mother. How old is the mother at present?
questions.explanation: Let mother = 9x. Person = 2x. (2x + 10)/(9x + 10) = 4/11 => 22x + 110 = 36x + 40 => 14x = 70 => x = 5. Mother's present age = 9 * 5 = 45 years.

questions.questionText: The ratio of present ages of two persons is 5 : 7. 18 years ago, their ages were in the ratio 8 : 13. Find their present ages.
A man is 3 years older than his wife and four times as old as his son. If the son becomes 15 years old after 3 years, what is the present age of the wife?
questions.explanation: Son's present age = 15 - 3 = 12 years. Father's age = 4 * 12 = 48 years. Wife's age = 48 - 3 = 45 years.

questions.questionText: Five years ago, the average age of A, B, C, and D was 45 years. With E joining them now, the average age of all five becomes 49 years. How old is E?
questions.explanation: Present sum of A, B, C, D = 4 * 45 + 4 * 5 = 180 + 20 = 200 years. Present sum of all 5 = 5 * 49 = 245 years. E's age = 245 - 200 = 45 years.

questions.questionText: The sum of the ages of a father and son is 45 years. Five years ago, the product of their ages was 4 times the father's age at that time. Find their present ages.
questions.explanation: Let father = F, son = S. F + S = 45. (F - 5)(S - 5) = 4(F - 5) => S - 5 = 4 => S = 9 years. Father F = 45 - 9 = 36 years.

questions.questionText: The ratio of the ages of A and B at present is 4 : 3. 10 years earlier, the ratio was 3 : 2. Find the present age of A.
A man's age is three times the sum of the ages of his two children. In 5 years his age will be double the sum of their ages. Find the father's age.
questions.concept: Father to Dual Child Age Doubling

questions.questionText: The average age of a group of 8 persons is increased by 2 years when two of them whose ages are 20 and 24 years are replaced by two new persons. What is the average age of the two new persons?
questions.explanation: Sum of new = 20 + 24 + 8 * 2 = 44 + 16 = 60 years. Average = 60 / 2 = 30 years.

questions.questionText: The present age of a father is four times that of his son. 5 years ago, the father was 7 times as old as his son was then. What is the present age of the son?
In a family of 5 members, the average age 3 years ago was 17 years. A baby having been born, the average age of the family is the same today. What is the age of the baby?
questions.explanation: Present sum of 5 members = 5 * 17 + 5 * 3 = 85 + 15 = 100 years. Present sum of 6 members = 6 * 17 = 102 years. Baby's age = 102 - 100 = 2 years.

questions.questionText: A is 20 years older than B. 5 years ago, A was 3 times as old as B. What is B's present age?
The ratio of ages of a husband and wife is 4 : 3. At the time of their marriage, the ratio was 5 : 3 and after 4 years from now the ratio will be 9 : 7. How many years ago were they married?
questions.explanation: (4x + 4)/(3x + 4) = 9/7 => 28x + 28 = 27x + 36 => x = 8. Present ages: Husband = 32, Wife = 24. Let married m years ago: (32 - m)/(24 - m) = 5/3 => 96 - 3m = 120 - 5m => 2m = 24 => m = 12 years.

questions.questionText: A mother is twice as old as her son. 20 years ago, the age of the mother was 10 times the age of the son. What is the present age of the mother?
The ages of Sunil and Gopal are in the ratio 2 : 3. If Sunil was 6 years younger than Gopal 5 years ago, what will be Sunil's age after 5 years?
questions.explanation: Age difference is invariant: 3x - 2x = x = 6 years. Sunil's present age = 2 * 6 = 12 years. After 5 years = 12 + 5 = 17 years.

questions.questionText: The sum of the ages of 4 persons is 84. What was the sum of their ages 5 years ago?
questions.explanation: Past sum = 84 - 4 * 5 = 84 - 20 = 64 years.

questions.questionText: A man's age is 150% of what it was 10 years ago, and 75% of what it will be 10 years hence. What is his present age?
A father is 28 years older than his daughter. In 6 years, he will be thrice as old as his daughter. Find the daughter's present age.
The ratio of present ages of A and B is 7 : 9. If the difference between their ages is 6 years, find A's age.
questions.explanation: 9x - 7x = 2x = 6 => x = 3. A's age = 7 * 3 = 21 years.

questions.questionText: The average age of a husband, wife, and their son was 42 years at the time of the son's marriage. After 1 year, a child was born and after 6 years of marriage the average age of the family became 36 years. What was the age of the bride at the time of marriage?
questions.explanation: Sum of H, W, S at marriage = 3 * 42 = 126. After 6 years, sum of H, W, S = 126 + 3 * 6 = 144. Child's age at 6 years after marriage (born at 1 year) = 5 years. Total family of 5 (H, W, S, Bride, Child) after 6 years = 5 * 36 = 180. Bride's age after 6 years = 180 - (144 + 5) = 180 - 149 = 31 years. Bride's age at marriage = 31 - 6 = 25 years.
questions.concept: Marriage and Child Multi-Year Family Shift

questions.questionText: The present age of a man is 7 times the age of his son. In 5 years, he will be 4 times as old as his son. What is the son's present age?
A father is 20 years older than his son. In 10 years, he will be twice as old as his son. What is the present age of the father?
